bestPractices.title: How do you design your workload service architecture?
bestPractices.description: Adopt distributed service architectures and loosely coupled components to withstand component degradation.

checks.title: ALB cross-zone load balancing enabled across all targets
checks.description: Ensures even traffic distribution across multiple Availability Zones to prevent target overload.

checks.title: Multi-AZ redundancy enabled for production RDS & Aurora clusters
checks.description: Automates synchronous standby replication for rapid failover during AZ outages.

checks.title: Route 53 latency-based DNS routing configured for failover
checks.description: Routes end users to the healthiest and lowest-latency region automatically.

bestPractices.title: How do you monitor workload resources to prevent degradation?
bestPractices.description: Implement real-time health checks, metrics, and automated alerts on all ingress and compute paths.

checks.title: ALB target group missing active health check configuration
checks.description: Target groups without active health checks will route live traffic to unhealthy or terminated instances.

checks.title: CloudWatch alarms configured for CPU, memory, and disk IOPS thresholds
checks.description: Sends automated P1/P2 paging notifications when utilization spikes beyond 80%.

checks.title: Automated synthetic canary monitoring on critical API endpoints
checks.description: Continuously validates login and checkout user journeys every 60 seconds.

bestPractices.title: How do you design distributed systems to mitigate cascading failures?
bestPractices.description: Use queues, throttling, dead-letter queues, and graceful degradation for resilient messaging.

checks.title: SQS Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) missing for asynchronous order processing queue
checks.description: Poison-pill messages can stall consumer workers indefinitely without a configured dead-letter queue.

checks.title: Exponential backoff and retry jitter implemented in microservice clients
checks.description: Prevents thundering herd problems when downstream services recover from blips.

bestPractices.title: How do you plan for disaster recovery (DR)?
bestPractices.description: Establish automated backups, cross-region replication, and validated recovery objectives.

checks.title: Cross-region automated snapshot copying configured for PostgreSQL databases
checks.description: Preserves daily incremental backups in a secondary geographic region.

checks.title: S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) active with versioning for critical storage
checks.description: Protects critical business documents against regional storage partition failures.

checks.title: Documented Recovery Time Objective (RTO < 1h) and RPO (< 15m) validation
checks.description: Regular automated drills verify restore times against business SLAs.

bestPractices.title: How do you manage identities and permissions for people and machines?
bestPractices.description: Apply principle of least privilege, enforce multi-factor authentication, and rotate machine credentials.

checks.title: IAM role with wildcard resource permission (*) on S3 and DynamoDB
checks.description: Production worker role grants overly permissive Action: * on sensitive data stores.

checks.title: IAM credentials and access keys unused for 90+ days deactivated
checks.description: Stale access keys pose an unauthorized credential harvesting vector.

checks.title: MFA enforced for all console and IAM administrative users
checks.description: Hardware or TOTP virtual MFA is mandated on all privileged login sessions.

checks.title: Root account access keys deleted and hardware MFA enabled
checks.description: Root credentials are locked in a vault with no active API keys present.

bestPractices.title: How do you protect network boundaries and traffic?
bestPractices.description: Layer network perimeters, restrict ingress rules, and inspect inbound traffic via WAF.

checks.title: Security group allows open ingress 0.0.0.0/0 on port 22 (SSH)
checks.description: Public bastion security group exposes SSH to the global internet without VPN restriction.

checks.title: AWS WAF attached to public Application Load Balancers
checks.description: Inspects web traffic with AWS managed rule sets against SQLi and XSS exploits.

checks.title: VPC Flow Logs enabled and delivered to centralized S3 security bucket
checks.description: Captures IP traffic metadata for continuous forensic analysis.

bestPractices.title: How do you classify and protect data at rest and in transit?
bestPractices.description: Enforce ubiquitous cryptographic protection, KMS key rotation, and strict transport layer security.

checks.title: S3 bucket missing server access logging and object lock protection
checks.description: Audit trails and immutability are disabled on customer telemetry storage.

checks.title: Default EBS volume encryption enabled using AWS KMS Customer Managed Keys
checks.description: All newly provisioned block volumes are encrypted at rest with CMK envelope keys.

checks.title: TLS 1.3 enforced on CloudFront distributions and ALB listeners
checks.description: Modern cipher suites are enforced with SSLv3 and TLS 1.0/1.1 disabled.

bestPractices.title: How do you detect and investigate security events?
bestPractices.description: Aggregate audit trails, enable continuous threat detection, and automate incident dispatch.

checks.title: AWS CloudTrail multi-region logging not enabled in secondary active regions
checks.description: API calls in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 are not captured in the master audit trail.

checks.title: Amazon GuardDuty threat detection enabled across all active regions
checks.description: Uses machine learning to identify anomalous DNS queries and unauthorized IAM activity.

checks.title: AWS Security Hub standards (CIS Benchmark & AWS Foundational) activated
checks.description: Aggregates security findings across all organizational accounts.

bestPractices.title: How do you de-provision unneeded resources and avoid waste?
bestPractices.description: Audit idle storage, unattached elastic IPs, and orphaned snapshots on a recurring schedule.

checks.title: 14 unattached EBS volumes incurring idle monthly charges ($342/mo)
checks.description: Detached volumes left over from terminated EC2 instances continue billing at provisioned rates.

checks.title: Idle Elastic IP addresses not attached to running instances released
checks.description: Unallocated public IPv4 addresses have been released to avoid hourly idle surcharges.

checks.title: Automated lifecycle cleanup for outdated EBS snapshots older than 90 days
checks.description: Snapshots are pruned according to data governance retention rules.

bestPractices.title: How do you evaluate cost when selecting and rightsizing services?
bestPractices.description: Leverage modern tiering, ARM64 architecture, and dynamic autoscaling to minimize baseline spend.

checks.title: S3 Lifecycle transition policies active for infrequent access & Glacier
checks.description: Objects older than 30 days automatically move to Glacier Instant Retrieval.

checks.title: Graviton3 (ARM64) instance families evaluated and deployed for container workloads
checks.description: Delivers up to 25% better compute price-performance over comparable x86 instances.

checks.title: Auto-scaling dynamic scaling policies tuned to match real-time traffic demand
checks.description: Target tracking policies scale down compute capacity during off-peak hours.

bestPractices.title: How do you manage pricing models and commitments?
bestPractices.description: Model workload baseline utilization and apply Savings Plans and Reserved Instances.

checks.title: Compute Savings Plans coverage is at 42% (recommended minimum: 70%)
checks.description: On-Demand compute spend can be optimized by extending 1-year No Upfront Compute Savings Plans.

checks.title: AWS Cost Anomaly Detection monitors daily spend anomalies with Slack alerts
checks.description: Automated machine learning identifies unexpected spend spikes within 24 hours.

bestPractices.title: How do you understand workload health and telemetry?
bestPractices.description: Define telemetry standards, centralized log aggregation, and automated recovery procedures.

checks.title: No automated backup retention policy configured for Amazon RDS instances
checks.description: Backup window and automated snapshot retention are not enforced via AWS Backup policy.

checks.title: Structured JSON logging enabled across all backend microservices
checks.description: Standardized schemas enable rapid query parsing in OpenSearch and CloudWatch Insights.

checks.title: OpenTelemetry distributed tracing integrated across API gateways
checks.description: Traces request journeys end-to-end through message queues and microservices.

bestPractices.title: How do you reduce deployment friction and operational risk?
bestPractices.description: Use Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, and automated rollback strategies.

checks.title: CI/CD deployment pipelines require automated pre-merge testing & linting
checks.description: Prevents defective build artifacts from reaching production environments.

checks.title: Blue/Green canary deployment strategy enabled on Amazon ECS Fargate services
checks.description: Routes 10% canary traffic before committing 100% of live workload traffic.

checks.title: Infrastructure defined entirely via version-controlled Terraform modules
checks.description: No manual console modifications are permitted in production VPCs.

bestPractices.title: How do you evolve operations and respond to incidents?
bestPractices.description: Maintain actionable runbooks, automate post-mortems, and test incident escalation paths.

checks.title: Incident runbooks not linked to critical CloudWatch alarm notifications
checks.description: On-call engineers lack immediate step-by-step remediation links inside alert payloads.

checks.title: Post-Incident Review (PIR) retrospectives and action tracking documented
checks.description: Action items from outages are tracked in Jira with mandatory SLA closure.

bestPractices.title: How do you select the best performing architecture?
bestPractices.description: Utilize edge caching, dedicated in-memory data tiers, and optimized compute instances.

checks.title: CloudFront CDN configured for global caching of static assets and API responses
checks.description: Reduces latency by terminating TLS and caching dynamic responses at 450+ edge PoPs.

checks.title: ElastiCache Redis cluster caching frequent database read queries
checks.description: Offloads high-frequency read queries to sub-millisecond in-memory cache.

checks.title: Modern 6th/7th generation EC2 instance families utilized for core compute
checks.description: Replaced legacy c4/m4 instances with nitro-based c6i/m6i compute nodes.

bestPractices.title: How do you monitor and optimize compute & data performance?
bestPractices.description: Identify data bottlenecks, scale read operations, and optimize storage IOPS.

checks.title: RDS database read replica missing for high-volume analytics queries
checks.description: Heavy reporting queries run against the primary DB writer, causing CPU contention.

checks.title: EBS volume provisioned IOPS (gp3) configured for optimal disk throughput
checks.description: Allocated 3,000 IOPS and 125 MB/s throughput independently of storage capacity.

checks.title: Enhanced networking (ENA) and jumbo frames active on internal VPC links
checks.description: Maximizes packet throughput between compute clusters and distributed storage.

complianceFrameworks.name: CIS Controls - 8.1
complianceFrameworks.description: Center for Internet Security (CIS) Controls Version 8.1 prioritized set of actions for cyber defense.

sections.title: 1. Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
sections.description: Actively manage all enterprise assets connected to the infrastructure.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
requirements.description: Utilize an active discovery tool to identify all cloud compute, storage, and serverless resources.

requirements.title: Address Unauthorized Assets in Multi-Cloud Accounts
requirements.description: Ensure automated alerting for untagged or rogue resource deployments.

requirements.title: Track Cloud Virtual Machines & Container Workloads
requirements.description: Maintain accurate real-time inventory of EC2 instances, EKS pods, and ECS tasks.

requirements.title: Maintain DHCP / VPC IP Address Allocation Logs
requirements.description: Retain VPC IPAM address allocation logs for audit correlation.
requirements.manualNote: Verified via quarterly network architecture reviews.

requirements.title: Periodic Audit of Connected SaaS & Cloud Integrations
requirements.description: Review third-party OAuth apps and cross-account IAM role assumptions.

sections.title: 2. Inventory and Control of Software Assets
sections.description: Manage software and container base images to prevent vulnerable code execution.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Software Inventory for Container Images
requirements.description: Ensure all ECR / ACR container images are cataloged with automated vulnerability scans.

requirements.title: Ensure Authorized Software Libraries in CI/CD Pipelines
requirements.description: Implement dependency lockfiles and automated CVE scanning in GitHub Actions.

requirements.title: Address Unauthorized Software and Deprecated Runtimes
requirements.description: Identify and decommission Lambda runtimes reaching end of life support.

requirements.title: Track Licensed Cloud Services and Cost Usage
requirements.description: Enforce FinOps license tracking for enterprise database engines.
requirements.manualNote: Reviewed via monthly AWS Cost Explorer billing audit.

requirements.title: Container Base Image Hardening
requirements.description: Verify distroless or Alpine hardened images used for production workloads.

requirements.title: Software Gatekeeping via Image Signature Verification
requirements.description: Enforce Cosign / AWS Signer image signing policies before Kubernetes admission.
requirements.manualNote: Kyverno policy validation required in cluster helm values.

requirements.title: Automated Software Package Version Enforcement
requirements.description: Scan AMI templates against CIS benchmarks before production baking.

sections.title: 3. Data Protection
sections.description: Processes and technical controls to identify, classify, handle, retain, and dispose of data.

requirements.title: Enforce Encryption at Rest for All S3 Buckets & Block Storage
requirements.description: All S3 buckets and EBS volumes must enforce AWS KMS Customer Managed Keys (CMK) encryption.
requirements.rationale: Unencrypted storage exposes sensitive transaction logs to unauthorized access or snapshots.
requirements.remediation: Enable default SSE-KMS encryption on the S3 bucket using terraform or AWS CLI.

requirements.title: Enforce TLS 1.3 Encryption in Transit for All Load Balancers
requirements.description: Disable legacy SSL/TLS ciphers on ALB, NLB, and CloudFront distributions.

requirements.title: Configure Data Classification Tags for Production Databases
requirements.description: Tag all RDS, DynamoDB, and Cloud SQL databases with data sensitivity classifications.

requirements.title: Enforce S3 Public Access Block at Account Level
requirements.description: Ensure S3 Block Public Access is active at the root account and organization level.

requirements.title: Automated Key Rotation for KMS CMKs
requirements.description: Enable yearly automated rotation for all KMS keys protecting customer PII.

sections.title: 4. Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
sections.description: Establish and maintain secure configurations across cloud networking and compute.

requirements.title: Ensure Security Groups Do Not Allow Unrestricted Inbound SSH (Port 22)
requirements.description: Security groups must restrict port 22 access to corporate VPN CIDRs or use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager.

requirements.title: Ensure Security Groups Do Not Allow Inbound RDP (Port 3389) from 0.0.0.0/0
requirements.description: Restrict Windows remote management ports to internal private subnets.

requirements.title: Enforce IMDSv2 on All EC2 Instances
requirements.description: Require Instance Metadata Service Version 2 to mitigate SSRF token exfiltration.

sections.title: 5. Account Management
sections.description: Processes and tools to assign and manage authorization to credentials and accounts.

requirements.title: Ensure No IAM Root User Access Keys Exist
requirements.description: Root accounts must not have active access keys; all administrative duties use IAM roles with MFA.

requirements.title: Enforce MFA for All IAM Users with Console Access
requirements.description: Multi-factor authentication must be enabled for all administrative and developer console logins.

requirements.title: Disable Unused Credentials Older Than 90 Days
requirements.description: Regularly identify and deactivate IAM access keys and user logins dormant for 90+ days.

sections.title: 6. Access Control Management
sections.description: Processes and tools to create, assign, manage, and revoke access credentials and privileges.

requirements.title: Enforce Least Privilege IAM Policies (No Full Admin Wildcards)
requirements.description: Avoid `AdministratorAccess` or wildcard `*` action permissions attached directly to IAM users.

requirements.title: Centralize Identity via Single Sign-On (SSO / IAM Identity Center)
requirements.description: Enforce SAML 2.0 / OIDC identity federation with Okta or Azure AD.

sections.title: 7. Continuous Vulnerability Management
sections.description: Plan to continuously assess and track vulnerabilities on all enterprise assets.

requirements.title: Enable Amazon Inspector / Defender for Cloud on All Workloads
requirements.description: Continuous automated vulnerability scanning enabled across EC2 instances, ECR repos, and Lambdas.

requirements.title: Automated Patch Management for OS Kernels
requirements.description: Use AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager with predefined maintenance windows.

sections.title: 8. Audit Log Management
sections.description: Collect, alert, review, and retain audit logs of events that could help detect or recover from attacks.

requirements.title: Ensure CloudTrail is Enabled Across All Multi-Cloud Regions with S3 Log Validation
requirements.description: Multi-region CloudTrail must be configured with log file validation enabled and logs delivered to a secure S3 bucket.
requirements.rationale: Missing log file validation prevents detection of tampered or deleted audit logs during forensic analysis.
requirements.remediation: Update CloudTrail configuration to enable `--enable-log-file-validation` and KMS log encryption.

requirements.title: Ensure VPC Flow Logs Are Enabled for All Active Production VPCs
requirements.description: VPC Flow Logs capture IP traffic metadata to identify port scanning, lateral movement, and data exfiltration.

requirements.title: Retain Audit Logs for at Least 365 Days in Object Storage with Object Lock
requirements.description: S3 audit log bucket must enforce WORM (Write Once Read Many) Object Lock compliance mode.
requirements.manualNote: Verified Glacier retention policy lifecycle rules.

complianceFrameworks.name: CMMC - 2.0
complianceFrameworks.description: Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC 2.0) framework for protecting Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI).

requirements.title: Limit Information System Access to Authorized Users
requirements.description: Authorize cloud access based on least privilege and separation of duties.

requirements.title: Control Information Flows Between System Components
requirements.description: Isolate CUI processing subnets with dedicated VPC Security Groups and Network ACLs.

requirements.title: Monitor, Control, and Protect Organizational Communications
requirements.description: Enforce boundary firewalls (AWS Network Firewall / Azure Firewall) at all public VPC ingress/egress points.

requirements.title: Implement Cryptographic Mechanisms for CUI in Transit
requirements.description: Enforce FIPS 140-3 validated cryptographic endpoints on all load balancers and API Gateways.

complianceFrameworks.name: CSA CCM - 4.0
complianceFrameworks.description: Cloud Security Alliance Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM v4) cybersecurity control framework for cloud customers and providers.

requirements.title: Asset Baseline & Secure Configuration
requirements.description: Validate hardening standards against CIS benchmarks for all compute nodes.

requirements.title: Dual-Region High Availability & Failover
requirements.description: Validate multi-region database replication and Route53 health check failovers.

requirements.title: Segregation of Privileged Roles
requirements.description: Enforce distinct separation between deployment roles and security auditor roles.

complianceFrameworks.name: DORA - 2022/2554
complianceFrameworks.description: EU Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) framework for operational resilience and ICT risk management in financial services.

requirements.title: ICT Systems Resilience & Real-Time Telemetry
requirements.description: CloudWatch dashboards and anomaly detection alerts configured across all financial transaction pipelines.

requirements.title: Protection and Prevention Capabilities
requirements.description: Automated DDoS mitigation with AWS Shield Advanced and WAF rate-limiting rules.

complianceFrameworks.name: FedRAMP 20x FRR Gloss Q - 2026.09.14
complianceFrameworks.description: Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program High Baseline Security Assessment Framework.

requirements.title: Event Logging Across All Cloud Management Plane APIs
requirements.description: Collect immutable audit records for every IAM and resource provisioning event.

complianceFrameworks.name: FedRAMP 20x KSI - 2026.07.14.01
complianceFrameworks.description: FedRAMP Key Security Indicators (KSI) continuous monitoring benchmark.

requirements.title: Malicious Code Protection for Cloud Storage Buckets
requirements.description: Automated malware and trojan virus scanning on all user-uploaded S3 objects via GuardDuty S3 Protection.

requirements.title: Information System Monitoring with GuardDuty Threat Detection
requirements.description: Amazon GuardDuty must be enabled across all accounts with automated finding export to Security Hub.

complianceFrameworks.name: SOC 2 Type II (2024)
complianceFrameworks.description: AICPA SOC 2 Type II Trust Services Criteria for Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, and Confidentiality.

sections.title: CC6: Logical and Physical Access Controls

requirements.title: Logical Access Security & Identity Boundaries
requirements.description: Enforce IAM role policies prohibiting wildcard administrative access in production VPCs.

requirements.title: Network Perimeter Boundaries and DMZ Segregation
requirements.description: Private subnets have no direct IGW routes; NAT Gateways used for egress.

requirements.title: Automated Vulnerability Alerting & Incident Notification
requirements.description: Slack/PagerDuty alerts triggered within 5 minutes of critical HRI detection.

complianceFrameworks.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
complianceFrameworks.description: International standard for Information Security Management Systems (ISMS) Annex A controls.

requirements.title: Data Leakage Prevention (DLP) across Object Storage
requirements.description: Configure Macie or automated regex scanners for customer data in S3 buckets.

requirements.title: Use of Cryptography & Key Management Lifecycles
requirements.description: Enforce envelope encryption with AWS KMS CMK across all persistent volumes.

complianceFrameworks.name: PCI-DSS v4.0
complianceFrameworks.description: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard v4.0 for cardholder data environments (CDE).

requirements.title: Primary Account Numbers (PAN) Must Be Rendered Unreadable
requirements.description: Strong cryptographic hash or envelope encryption enforced at all database columns.

complianceFrameworks.name: AWS Foundational Security Best Practices (FSBP)
complianceFrameworks.description: Curated set of automated AWS Security Hub controls aligning with AWS Security Pillar recommendations.

requirements.title: S3 Buckets Should Have Default Encryption Enabled
requirements.description: Checks whether default encryption is configured for S3 buckets.

requirements.title: S3 Buckets Should Require Requests to Use SSL (HTTPS)
requirements.description: Checks whether S3 bucket policies enforce secure transport via aws:SecureTransport condition.

requirements.title: IAM Policies Should Not Grant Full Administrative Privileges
requirements.description: Checks whether IAM policies contain `Action: *` with `Resource: *`.

orgQuestions.q: How does the organization enforce Service Control Policies (SCPs) and Landing Zone guardrails?
orgQuestions.desc: Preventive guardrails across multi-account hierarchy, region restrictions, and root lockouts.
orgQuestions.ans: AWS Organizations with AWS Control Tower enforces foundational SCPs denying unauthorized regions, root user usage, and public S3 bucket creation across all member accounts.

info.frameworkRef: AWS WAFR: SEC-02 · Azure Management Groups · GCP Resource Manager
info.whyItMatters: Centralized SCPs prevent member accounts from altering security baselines, enabling programmatic compliance at enterprise scale.
howToVerify: Open AWS Organizations > Policies > Service control policies (or Azure Policy initiative definitions).
Verify SCPs denying unapproved regions, disabling CloudTrail/Activity Logs, and preventing public storage bucket creation.
Validate that root user accounts have no active programmatic access keys and hardware MFA is enforced.
info.auditEvidence: AWS Organizations SCP JSON policy attachments list and Control Tower guardrail status report.

manualChecks.label: Service Control Policies (SCPs) active across all member accounts enforcing region & service restrictions
manualChecks.guidance: Verify SCP attachments in AWS Organizations root / OU levels or Azure Management Group policies

manualChecks.label: Root user account access restricted with hardware MFA and automated security alarm notifications
manualChecks.guidance: Inspect IAM Credential Report for root user last activity and verify SNS alarm on root login

orgQuestions.q: How is centralized audit logging and SIEM integration configured across accounts?
orgQuestions.desc: Aggregated CloudTrail logs, central Log Archive account, and real-time security alerts.
orgQuestions.ans: Organization-wide CloudTrail logs and VPC Flow Logs are replicated to a dedicated secure Log Archive account with SIEM ingestion.

info.frameworkRef: AWS WAFR: SEC-04 · Centralized Audit Architecture
info.whyItMatters: Centralizing audit telemetry in an immutable, restricted-access account prevents tampering during security incidents and enables comprehensive cross-account forensic investigation.
howToVerify: Verify organization trail in master account sending logs to a dedicated Log Archive S3 bucket.
Confirm destination S3 bucket has Object Lock (WORM compliance) and MFA Delete enabled.
Check connector status for enterprise SIEM (Datadog, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel) streaming cross-account audit events.
info.auditEvidence: Organization CloudTrail configuration export and SIEM ingestion heartbeat dashboard screenshot.

manualChecks.label: Immutable log archive bucket configured with Object Lock (WORM) & MFA Delete enabled
manualChecks.guidance: Inspect central S3 / Blob storage compliance settings in dedicated Log Archive account

manualChecks.label: SIEM connector (Datadog / Splunk / Sentinel) actively streaming cross-account telemetry and alarms
manualChecks.guidance: Confirm active data stream ingestion rate and real-time alerting rule triggers

orgQuestions.q: How does the organization manage centralized budgets, cost allocation tags, and showback/chargeback?
orgQuestions.desc: Enterprise tagging policies, AWS Cost Categories, and centralized consolidated billing governance.
orgQuestions.ans: AWS Cost Categories and mandatory Cost Center tagging policies enforced via AWS Organizations with monthly budget threshold alerts sent to Slack.

info.frameworkRef: AWS WAFR: COST-01 & COST-02 · FinOps Foundation Standards
info.whyItMatters: Standardized cost allocation tags and automated budget notifications foster engineering accountability, eliminate orphaned resource waste, and prevent budget overruns.
howToVerify: Inspect Tag Policies in AWS Organizations for mandatory tags (Environment, Owner, CostCenter, Project).
Verify AWS Budgets threshold alerts connected to finance and engineering Slack / email distribution channels.
Review Cost Categories and monthly FinOps unit economics reporting hierarchy.
info.auditEvidence: AWS Tag Policy compliance report and AWS Budgets threshold notification settings export.

manualChecks.label: Mandatory organizational cost tags enforced via Tag Policies (Owner, CostCenter, Env, Project)
manualChecks.guidance: Inspect Tag Policies under AWS Organizations console or Azure Policy tag governance

manualChecks.label: Consolidated billing budget alerts configured with multi-tiered notification thresholds (80%, 100%)
manualChecks.guidance: Verify AWS Budgets or Azure Cost Management threshold alerts routed to finance channels

orgQuestions.q: How are organization-wide disaster recovery and incident escalation runbooks standardized?
orgQuestions.desc: Cross-account disaster recovery SLAs, enterprise on-call rotations, and executive post-mortem reviews.
orgQuestions.ans: P1 disaster recovery runbooks with cross-region replication SLAs (RPO < 15 min, RTO < 1 hour) and bi-weekly PagerDuty on-call drill reviews.

info.frameworkRef: AWS WAFR: OPS-10 & REL-13 · Enterprise Incident Management
info.whyItMatters: Well-rehearsed disaster recovery procedures and clear escalation hierarchies guarantee predictable, rapid operational response during major enterprise disruptions.
howToVerify: Review the enterprise incident severity matrix (P1–P4) and on-call paging rotations in PagerDuty / Opsgenie.
Verify cross-region backup replication schedules, RPO/RTO validation tests, and annual DR exercise sign-offs.
Confirm Post-Incident Review (PIR) template and central repository in Confluence / Notion.
info.auditEvidence: Annual DR Exercise Signoff document and post-incident review (PIR) archive.

manualChecks.label: Standardized incident severity matrix (P1–P4) with documented paging rotations and SLAs
manualChecks.guidance: Review runbook repository and escalation ladder in on-call management tooling

manualChecks.label: Annual enterprise DR game day or cross-region failover drill conducted and formally documented
manualChecks.guidance: Review sign-off report and recovery timeline from the most recent failover drill

orgQuestions.q: Which organizational compliance frameworks and data residency standards are mandated across accounts?
orgQuestions.desc: Enterprise compliance baselines (SOC2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI-DSS) and sovereign boundary controls.
orgQuestions.ans: SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 compliance standards are enforced organization-wide using AWS Security Hub and AWS Config conformance packs across all member accounts.

info.frameworkRef: AWS WAFR: SEC-01 · Enterprise Compliance & Risk Management
info.whyItMatters: Embedding mandated regulatory standards into automated guardrails early prevents costly compliance remediation and guarantees sovereign data boundaries.
howToVerify: Inspect automated compliance monitoring in AWS Security Hub / Microsoft Defender for Cloud / GCP Security Command Center.
Confirm continuous compliance scoring against CIS Benchmarks and SOC 2 / ISO 27001 standards.
Verify data residency boundaries preventing data replication outside designated sovereign jurisdictions.
info.auditEvidence: Security Hub CIS Benchmark score export or third-party compliance audit certificate.

manualChecks.label: Automated continuous compliance monitoring enabled (Security Hub / Defender for Cloud / AWS Config)
manualChecks.guidance: Check Security Hub standards activation (CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark & AWS Foundational Best Practices)

manualChecks.label: Data sovereignty and geographic boundary restrictions formally documented and enforced
manualChecks.guidance: Review SCP region restrictions and database backup replication target regions
